title: Feline Blood Donation in Edinburgh | BHOC Veterinary
description: How Edinburgh’s Hospital for Small Animals found a compatible feline donor for Frank and collected blood from Max in under four hours.
heading: How a donor cat helped Frank after emergency surgery in Edinburgh
lead: The blood draw took about five minutes. Finding and screening a compatible donor and collecting the blood took under four hours.
paragraphs: The University of Edinburgh reported on 9 November that Frank, a seven-year-old domestic shorthair, needed an emergency transfusion after blood loss during surgery to remove a brain tumour. The Hospital for Small Animals contacted owners on its local feline donor list.

Max, a one-year-old Maine Coon with a compatible blood type, donated 35 mL after screening. The hospital reported that Frank improved after the transfusion, went home seven days later and was recovering well at a follow-up visit.

For veterinary teams, the case shows what a local donor list can make possible. Tracking the time spent reaching owners, screening donors and collecting blood can help a clinic identify where to improve its emergency response.
